items.headline: Georgia flips script on Trinidad Chambliss, dominates Ole Miss in statement win
items.description: No. 2 Georgia finally contained Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss, holding him without a passing touchdown en route to a 42-7 blowout win over the No. 10 Rebels on Saturday.

items.headline: It's Week 10 and everything remains up for grabs in college football
items.description: There were plenty of top-ranked matchups in Week 10, but the results didn't solidify anything.

items.headline: Gunner Stockton and No. 2 Georgia pound No. 12 Mississippi 42-7 to make case for top ranking
items.description: — Gunner Stockton passed for four touchdowns and ran for another Saturday night as No. 2 Georgia coasted to a 42-7 win over No. 12 Mississippi.

items.headline: Gunner Stockton, Georgia dominate Ole Miss 42-7
items.description: Gunner Stockton, Georgia dominate Ole Miss 42-7

items.headline: Film shows why Rebels' Chambliss will challenge Georgia's defense
items.description: SEC Now's Benjamin Watson and Chris Doering break down how Trinidad Chambliss' skill set and No. 10 Ole Miss' offensive scheme could pose problems for No. 2 Georgia.

items.headline: Matt Barrie on massive Week 10: 'This is the tipping point weekend'
items.description: Barrie says the the conclusion of Saturday's slate will flip the entire football landscape on its axis due to the amount of ranked, decisive games as the CFP approaches.
